newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean shrs make U-turn, close soft on Greenspan.
newsitem.headline: Chilean shrs make U-turn, close soft on Greenspan.

text.p: After opening strongly higher, Chilean stocks swung downwards midday to close weaker following a warning from Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan that U.S. stock prices may have risen too much.
The bolsa's opening mood Thursday will be unsettled with investors analyzing the impact of Greenspan's remarks, said Jaime Pena y Lillo, portfolio manager at brokerage Socimer.
"Tomorrow will be difficult as people will now be very cautious," said Pena y Lillo.
The 40-share index, which had climbed over one percent midsession, ended down 0.05 percent at 118.37 points.
